The New Uniform
The wardrobe,
seen with fresh
eyes.
78 / Ivory Column
A long-sleeved ivory turtleneck and a
fluid, asymmetric ivory midi skirt with a
sheer hem, worn with a dark shoulder
bag and tall brown buckled boots. Long
light-brown waves and a pale cream
sock peek out against a textured beige
wall and a blue carpet stacked with
books.
FASHION, FILM & VISUAL STUDIES
